summary: Feed s068_single is degraded: 27.9% of frames are truncated/sliced to ~256 bytes, breaking full-payload inspection required by the IDS. All other checks (duplicates, encryption, VLAN, one-way, oversize, drops, overload, tunnel) are healthy.

findings.root_cause: Packet broker is configured to slice/truncate packets to ~256 bytes snaplen (503 of 1806 frames, 27.9% exceeds 5% threshold), likely to save bandwidth/tool capacity.
findings.impact_on_tool: IDS needs full payload for signature and anomaly detection; truncated packets hide application payload, causing missed exploits, malware and C2 detection and increased false negatives.

recommended_fix.why: IDS requires full payload per tool profile (needs_full_payload=true); forwarding unsliced frames restores complete L7 inspection coverage.
